Lord '''Oswalt''' is a [[Tairen]] nobleman who pledged himself to become a [[Hunter of the Horn]].

== History ==
Lord Oswalt researched the potential location of the [[Horn of Valere]] in the Great Library of [[Cairhien]]. He found a tale of [[Artur Hawkwing]]'s trumpeter, who retired to a tower in the [[Hills of Kintara]] after the death of the High King. Some records said that he found the horn, and Oswalt believed that the Horn was located there. He managed to find a map with the precise location, and believed that no-one else would have the exact map and the information he did in his search for the Horn.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
